description: Conversion of garage into habitable room; front porch; single storey rear extension; external alterations including installation of external staircase at rear
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The proposed external staircase, by reason of the
siting and positioning, would result in unacceptable direct and perceived
overlooking of neighbouring habitable rooms and private rear gardens, having a
detrimental impact on neighbour amenity contrary to the National Planning
Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3 and D6 of the London Plan (2021), Policies
GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041) and the Residential Design Guide
Supplementary Planning Document (2010).<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">The proposed rear staircase, by reason of its design and the extent of rearward projection, would be an unduly obtrusive and incongruous addition to the rear elevation of this row of terraced housing having a detrimental impact on the visual amenity of occupiers of&nbsp; adjacent properties, contrary to Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041), and Supplementary Planning Guidance - "Residential Design Guide" (2010).</span></p>
